desc: Ideation/proof: reduce to selecting 2K cakes with even color counts and show an optimal repair from the top-2K basis needs at most two recolor/swap operations.
Implement parser, unconstrained basis, total, base colors, and parity mask.
Build TOP=5 selected/unselected candidate lists and generate directed recolor/swap operations with losses.
Enumerate single and compatible pair operations to find minimum parity-repair loss and output answers.
Validate on samples and edge cases (N=2, N=2K, many ties, K=1, no unselected cakes).
